title: Chapter 1397 - 13: Breaking Through To The Immortal Path
content:
Chapter 1397 - 13: Breaking Through To The Immortal Path

Chapter 1397: Chapter 13: Breaking Through to the Immortal Path

Space distorted, and several figures materialized.

Standing at the forefront was a young man. He had black hair and black eyes, a tall and straight figure, with a terrifying aura.

The other figures were either middle-aged men or hunched old men, evidently roles similar to Protectors.

"Young master, in front of us is the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, the residence of the Great Emperor of the Human Race."

The hunched old man with wrinkled skin stopped and looked far ahead at the majestic palace, speaking softly.

"Tianyuan Emperor Palace?"

The young man with black hair had a sharp gaze, revealing a fighting spirit.

Ever since the Emperor Tianyuan swept through many Forbidden Zones of ancient races twenty thousand years ago, the Human Race ushered in an unprecedented era of cultivation prosperity.

In these twenty thousand years, countless cultivation geniuses of the Human Race, with special physiques and more, have emerged, striving to showcase their brilliance.

As a cultivation prodigy, naturally aiming for the strongest of the Human Race, the young man’s purpose here was to challenge the Emperor Tianyuan, paving the way for his emperor’s path.

In terms of strength, the young man was already at the Quasi-Emperor realm, in this world, the lifespan limit of cultivators below the Great Emperor is about one hundred thousand years.

Many cultivation talents enter Quasi-Emperor at several thousand or ten thousand years old, the young man was in such a category.

"Young master, do you really intend to challenge the Great Emperor?"

Another middle-aged man hesitantly asked, evidently not very optimistic about the young man.

"Lu, I’ve been a Quasi-Emperor for more than ten thousand years, once ventured deep into Forbidden Zones, fought those ancient Supreme Beings, never met defeat, even if I’m not the opponent of Emperor Tianyuan, presumably I won’t lose too badly."

The young man said, he wasn’t aiming to defeat Emperor Tianyuan, but wished to experience the power of this legendary emperor up close.

The Protectors exchanged glances, not saying much.

The young man indeed had returned unscathed from Forbidden Zones multiple times, although merely a Quasi-Emperor, his combat strength wasn’t much weaker than Supreme Emperors.

Relying on special bloodlines and inherited methods, a Quasi-Emperor also has the hope to challenge a Great Emperor.

But Emperor Tianyuan?

Emperor Tianyuan was no ordinary Great Emperor.

The combat strength displayed twenty thousand years ago, at least started from the supreme emperor level.

"Rest assured, even if defeated by Emperor Tianyuan, my state of mind won’t waver."

The young man said, he had immense respect for Emperor Tianyuan, without this legendary emperor, how could the Human Race have such a thriving cultivation era as now?

Without Emperor Tianyuan sweeping the ancient race Forbidden Zones, any slightly talented Human Race cultivator would face foreign suppression and assassination.

The young man knew personally, without the deterrence of Emperor Tianyuan, how could he venture deep into Forbidden Zones and escape unharmed?

If those ancient Forbidden Zone Masters slightly awakened parts of their strength, it still could bring him irreversible consequences.

A Quasi-Emperor hopes to challenge a Great Emperor indeed, but ultimately isn’t a true Great Emperor, facing those ancient Forbidden Zone Masters requires utmost caution from even Great Emperors, let alone Quasi-Emperors.

"Young master, it’s good you think this way."

The Protectors slightly sighed with relief.

They all experienced the era when foreign races were dominant, becoming increasingly aware of the terror of Emperor Tianyuan.

Among many ancient supreme emperors, forcing a sweep through, such a feat wasn’t achieved by many throughout time.

Unfortunately, since Emperor Tianyuan acted twenty thousand years ago, he hasn’t moved a second time, which is why many Human Race cultivation talents are eager to challenge him now.

Most Human Race cultivation talents were born in the past twenty thousand years, not having experienced the era dominated by foreign races, their reverence for Emperor Tianyuan isn’t ingrained.

Yet they can still bring forth the thought of challenge.

...

Soon.

The young man with his group reached outside the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

"So many people."

The young man looked around, startled.

Outside the palace, scattered here and there, sat several dozen to several hundred figures in meditation.

These figures exuded terrifying auras, most not inferior to him at all.

"That’s... Yu Taiyin with the Bright Moon God King Body?"

"And Black Altar King with Devouring God bloodline?"

"The Chaos Body, rare throughout the ages..."

...

The young man’s brow twitched.

Yu Taiyin was a peerless Quasi-Emperor from fifteen thousand years ago, his Bright Moon God King Body was a top special physique, in that era, he had no equal among the Human Race, ventured into Forbidden Zones, battling ancient Supreme Beings.

Unfortunately, Yu Taiyin suddenly disappeared, with many thinking he attempted to cross into the Great Emperor realm.

Unexpectedly, after fifteen thousand years missing, Yu Taiyin was encountered here.

Black Altar King with Devouring God bloodline was also a peerless Quasi-Emperor, his path was devouring everything, similarly disappeared at a certain stage...

The Chaos Body too, this world’s incarnation of such a physique was hailed as the next Great Emperor of the Human Race, but ultimately it came to nothing.

The young man examined closely, among the figures he knew some, and others he didn’t.

But the latter could sit alongside the former, indicating their considerable strength wasn’t lacking.

"Are you here to challenge Emperor Tianyuan too?"

As the young man stood in awe, Yu Taiyin sitting closest opened his eyes and casually said: "From there, it’s thirty-three steps to the front of the palace, if you can cross these thirty-three steps, reach the front of the palace, you can meet Emperor Tianyuan and challenge him."

"So simple?" the young man blurted.
